unreachable.title: Can't reach the server
unreachable.text: The {{app}} server didn't answer. It may be starting up or stopped.

insecure.title: This connection isn't encrypted
insecure.text: Open this app over HTTPS — for example {{example}} with Tailscale. Signing in isn't possible over an unencrypted connection.

login.description: Sign in to manage your server.

setup.heading: Set up {{app}}
setup.description: Create the owner account. You'll need the setup code the installer printed.
setup.setupCodeHelp: Shown at the end of installation. Lost it? Run {{command}} on the server.
setup.passwordHelp: At least {{passwordMin}} characters. A few random words work well.

account.title: Change password
account.description: You'll stay signed in here; other devices are signed out.

validation.setupCodeInvalid: This is not a valid setup code
validation.diskNameInvalid: Use up to {{diskNameMax}} lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit.
validation.diskUuidInvalid: This disk can't be named by its ID.

errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.tooManyAttemptsIn_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.tooManyAttemptsIn_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.invalid_setup_token: This setup code is not valid
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.container_protected: This container is part of the platform itself and can't be stopped or restarted here.
errors.docker_unavailable: Docker isn't reachable right now. Make sure it's running and try again.
errors.action_failed: Docker couldn't do it. The container's logs may tell why.
errors.catalog_entry_not_found: This service isn't in the catalog.
errors.busy: Another operation (an install, a backup, a restore or a disk being mounted) is running. Try again when it has finished.
errors.port_in_use: This port is already in use.
errors.port_reserved: This port is reserved for the system.
errors.path_not_allowed: This folder is not in an allowed area.
errors.policy_violation: This service's recipe was refused by the safety checks.
errors.compose_failed: The service could not be started. The output shows why.
errors.executor_unavailable: This server isn't set up for this yet.
errors.timed_out: This took too long and was stopped.
errors.interrupted: The app restarted while this was running.
errors.audit_unavailable: Nothing was done: the action couldn't be recorded in the audit log.
errors.destination_unavailable: The backup disk isn't connected (or isn't mounted). Nothing was written.
errors.destination_not_allowed: Choose one of the disks listed: a disk mounted under /mnt or /media.
errors.repository_mismatch: The backups on this disk aren't the ones set up here. Nothing was written.
errors.repository_exists: This disk already has a backup folder that wasn't set up here.
errors.passphrase_invalid: The backup passphrase on this server is missing or wrong.
errors.source_missing: A folder to back up is missing.
errors.service_not_stopped: The service couldn't be stopped for its backup, so it wasn't backed up.
errors.service_not_restarted: The service didn't start again after its backup. Start it on the Containers page.
errors.dump_failed: The app's database couldn't be saved.
errors.repository_damaged: The check found damage in the backups.
errors.borg_failed: The backup program reported an error. Its output has the details.
errors.backup_item_not_found: That is not in the backups (any more).
errors.backup_item_fixed: This app itself is always backed up.
errors.backup_restore_not_found: There is nothing to delete for this restore.
errors.service_not_backed_up: This service can't be backed up.
errors.paths_changed: The service uses other folders now. Restore to a new folder instead.
errors.invalid_plan: The backup program refused this change. Nothing was changed.
errors.backup_set_aside_kept: A restore still keeps the previous version of this. Delete that first (on the restore), then its backups.
errors.disk_not_found: This disk isn't connected any more.
errors.disk_in_use: This disk is in use: mounted already, swap, or part of another device.
errors.system_disk: The system runs from this disk: it isn't changed here.
errors.unsupported_filesystem: This disk's format can't be mounted here (ext4, XFS, Btrfs and exFAT can).
errors.name_taken: This name is in use. Choose another.
errors.not_managed: This disk wasn't mounted here, so it isn't unmounted here either.
errors.used_for_backups: Backups are kept on this disk. Choose another backup disk first.
errors.disk_busy: Files on this disk are open. Close them, or stop what uses them, and try again.
errors.mount_failed: The disk could not be mounted. Nothing was changed.
errors.unmount_failed: The disk could not be unmounted.
errors.duplicate_uuid: Another disk has the same ID (a copied disk?). Unplug one of them to mount this one.

unreachable.title: Docker isn't reachable
unreachable.text: Container information is unavailable right now. Make sure Docker is running; this page updates by itself once it is.

stop.title: Stop {{name}}?
stop.text: It will be unreachable until you start it again.

restart.title: Restart {{name}}?
restart.text: It will be unreachable for a moment while it restarts.

empty.title: No log output yet
empty.text: New lines appear here as soon as the container writes them.

stopped.title: Container is stopped
stopped.text: These are its logs up to when it stopped. Start it again to see new output.

removed.title: Container was removed
removed.text: It no longer exists. The lines already loaded stay here until you leave this page.

notFound.title: Container not found
notFound.text: There is no container named “{{name}}”. It may have been removed, or the link is out of date.

unavailable.title: Logs are not available
unavailable.text: This container’s logging setting (its “log driver”, for example none or syslog) keeps no logs that Docker can read back.

error.title: Docker isn't reachable
error.text: The logs can’t be read right now. Make sure Docker is running, then try again.

refused.title: Too many log views open
refused.text: This browser tab already shows logs of as many containers as it can at once. Close one, then try again.

navidrome.description: Your own music streaming server: play your music collection in the browser or with any Subsonic app on your phone.

WEB_PORT.label: Web port
WEB_PORT.help: The port Navidrome's web page opens on.

MUSIC_DIR.label: Music folder
MUSIC_DIR.help: Where your music is. Navidrome only reads it, it never changes or deletes files.

DATA_DIR.label: Data folder
DATA_DIR.help: Where Navidrome keeps its database, playlists and covers.

immich.description: Back up and browse your photos and videos, with automatic upload from your phone, albums, faces and search.

WEB_PORT.label: Web port
WEB_PORT.help: The port Immich's web page and phone app connect to.

UPLOAD_DIR.label: Photo library folder
UPLOAD_DIR.help: Where Immich stores your photos and videos. Immich manages this folder: add and delete photos in Immich, not here.

TZ.label: Time zone
TZ.help: For dates in the logs, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

backup.restoreNote: Your photos and videos are back. Albums, people and Immich's other data live in its database: its latest database backup came back with the photos — restore it in Immich (Immich's documentation explains how).

installed.title: Installed
installed.none: Nothing installed yet. Pick a service from the catalog below.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Reviewed services you can install with one click.
catalog.failed: The catalog couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.text: Its containers are deleted. Its data and settings are kept, so you can install it again later.

services.notFound: This service isn't in the catalog.

form.duration: Installing downloads the images and starts the service. This can take a few minutes; you can follow it on the services page.
form.secretKept: Leave empty to keep the current one
form.includeInBackupsHelp: Its folders are backed up with the next backup.

access.title: {{name}} will be able to:
access.volumes: Keep its own data in Docker volumes
access.generatedSecrets: Use passwords made for it, stored encrypted and never shown

backups.failed: The backups couldn't be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

setup.title: Set up backups
setup.text: Your services' data, chosen folders and this app are backed up every day — encrypted, and only changes take space. Backups run even when this app is down.
setup.noDisk: No disk is mounted under /mnt or /media. Connect a USB disk or a second drive and mount it on the Disks page.
setup.unsupported: This disk's format can't be used for backups.
setup.sameDisk: This is the same disk as your data: if it breaks, the backups are gone too. A separate disk is safer.
setup.hasRepository: It already holds a backup folder.
setup.when: 2. When, and how long they're kept
setup.done: Backups are set up. The first one runs at the time you chose — or start it now.

retention.title: Backups kept
retention.summary: Keeps one backup a day for {{daily}} days, one a week for {{weekly}} weeks and one a month for {{monthly}} months.

passphrase.title: Your backup passphrase
passphrase.firstText: Write these six words down now, or save them in your password manager. Without them, your backups can't be opened on another machine.
passphrase.text: Keep these six words safe: they open your backups.
passphrase.keep: Keep it apart from this server: if the server is lost, this passphrase and the backup disk bring everything back.
passphrase.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the words and copy them yourself.
passphrase.againHint: Lost the passphrase? You can see it again with your password.
passphrase.againText: Enter your password to see the backup passphrase.

overview.title: Backups
overview.never: Not everything is backed up yet

serviceNotRestarted.title: A service didn't start again
serviceNotRestarted.text: It was stopped for its backup and didn't start again. Start it on the Containers page.

repositoryDamaged.title: The backups are damaged
repositoryDamaged.text: The last check found damage on the backup disk. Back up now; if it keeps happening, the disk may be failing.

lastRunFailed.title: The last backup failed
lastRunFailed.text: Something wasn't backed up. See what happened below.

noRecentBackup.title: No backup for more than two days
noRecentBackup.text: Something hasn't been backed up for a while. Check that the backup disk is connected.

destinationUnavailable.title: The backup disk isn't connected
destinationUnavailable.text: Connect it (and mount it) so backups can run.

lowSpace.title: The backup disk is almost full
lowSpace.text: Keep fewer backups, or use a bigger disk.

items.title: What's backed up
items.platform: This app: its settings, its database and its keys
items.platformHelp: Always backed up — with your passphrase, it brings this app back on a new machine.
items.addFailed: Couldn't add it to the backups
items.removeFailed: Couldn't remove it from the backups
items.removedText: Their backups are kept until you delete them.

remove.title: Stop backing up {{name}}?
remove.text: Its existing backups are kept, so you can still restore them.
remove.alsoDelete: Also delete its backups (this can't be undone)
remove.deleteText: All its backups are deleted from the disk. This can't be undone.

folders.title: Choose a folder
folders.text: Folders in the service storage and home folders can be backed up.
folders.unreadable: This app may not look inside, but the folder can still be backed up.

restore.title: Restore
restore.text: Choose a backup and where it goes.
restore.none: There are no backups of this yet.
restore.inPlaceText: The service is stopped, its current folders are set aside (kept until you delete them), the backup is put back, and the service starts again.
restore.newFolderText: Into a new folder under /srv/homelab/restores. Nothing else changes.
restore.reinstall: Then install the service again — its previous settings are filled in.
restore.started: Restoring. You can follow it on this page.
restore.setAside: The previous version is kept here until you delete it:

settings.title: Settings
settings.newDisk: Another disk starts a new set of backups. The backups on the old disk stay there.

run.started: Backup started. You can follow it on this page.

disks.intro: The disks connected to this machine. Mount one to use it — for backups, for example. It stays mounted after a restart.
disks.failed: The disks could not be read.
disks.systemHelp: The system runs from this disk. Nothing on it is changed here.
disks.inUseHelp: Used as swap, or part of RAID, LVM or encryption.
disks.unsupportedHelp: Only ext4, XFS, Btrfs and exFAT can be mounted here.
disks.mountedElsewhere: Mounted by the system, not here: it isn't unmounted here.
disks.disconnectedText: Mounted here before. Each is mounted again when its disk is connected.

mountDialog.title: Mount {{name}}
mountDialog.text: Choose a name for its folder.
mountDialog.name: Name
mountDialog.kept: It stays mounted after a restart. If the disk isn't connected then, the machine starts as usual.

unmountDialog.title: Unmount this disk?
unmountDialog.text: Its files stay on the disk. Afterwards it can be unplugged safely. Close anything that uses it first.
unmountDialog.forgetText: It isn't mounted again when it's connected. Its files stay on the disk.

disks.unmounted: The disk is unmounted. It can be unplugged now.
disks.mountFailed: The disk could not be mounted.
disks.unmountFailed: The disk could not be unmounted.
disks.duplicateUuid: Another disk has the same ID (a copied disk?): either one could be mounted after a restart. Unplug one of them.
